tool_input.description: Determine actual hashCode(null) value via a scratch program

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ArrayUtilsAgentTest.java` with 37 self-contained JUnit 5 test methods covering `ArrayUtils`: the empty-array/constant fields, `add`/`addAll`/`addFirst`, `clone`, `concat`, `contains`/`containsAny`, `get`, `getComponentType`/`getDimensions`/`getLength`, `hashCode`, `indexesOf`/`indexOf`/`lastIndexOf`, `insert`, `isArrayIndexValid`, `isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty`, `isSameLength`/`isSameType`, deprecated `isEquals`, `isSorted`, `nullToEmpty`, `remove`/`removeAll`/`removeAllOccurrences`/`removeElement`/`removeElements`, `reverse`, `setAll`, `shift`, `shuffle`, `startsWith`, `subarray`, `swap`, `toArray`, `toMap`, `toObject`/`toPrimitive`, and `toString`/`toStringArray`. Each covers boundary cases (null/empty arrays, negative/out-of-range indices, type mismatches) and asserts on exceptions and returned values, not just happy paths. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
